name: reright
description: Hosted MCP server that rewrites text an agent drafted for people (emails, messages, posts, commit and PR text) so it reads human-written, with optional human approval before the agent uses it. rewrite sends the draft text to reright.it and counts against the account's monthly words; rewrite_result and keep_original only act on drafts the agent already sent. The Guard contribution is off by default. Disconnect the MCP server from the agent to prevent its calls.
saferAlternatives: Leave the server off and use the agent's draft as written instead of sending it to reright.

Use rewrite_result to read the state of a draft already sent. Use keep_original only when an unchecked rewrite changes a fact or reverses meaning, and quote the changed phrases. When review is enabled, reject pending rewrites in the review interface. Neither tool sends new text.
